description: A painted scene of an old laboratory bench. A glass funnel with brass taps drips amber liquid into a beaker, and a pair of hands draws fine glistening strands from the liquid onto a crank-driven spool. Wooden logs with bark and wood shavings lie in the foreground, with an oil lamp glowing at left and glass bottles on the bench. A man in a leather apron stands at right. No visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.
